title: Google Solitaire
description: Play the classic Klondike Solitaire card game.
about:
Google Solitaire is a browser game where you move cards between columns and foundations to complete Klondike Solitaire. Choose Easy or Hard to begin.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Move cards between columns and foundations to complete Klondike Solitaire. Choose Easy or Hard to begin.
tips: Use click / drag to move cards.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Google Solitaire?
faq.answer: Move cards between columns and foundations to complete Klondike Solitaire. Choose Easy or Hard to begin.

faq.question: Can I play Google Solitaire in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
